description.processtask_tab_layout: "description": "The position field pins a tab: above pins it to the top and below pins it to the bottom. In each layoutList item, key and top are required and description is optional. key uniquely identifies the tab. top controls whether the tab is pinned by default; true means pinned. The layoutList item order defines the pinned order from top to bottom and left to right. Tabs explicitly configured in layoutList appear first. Supported key values: report (Submission Content), collection (Task Collection), dataconversion (Data Conversion), eoa (Electronic Approval), subProcess (Subworkflow), autoexec (Automation), automatic (Automatic Processing), changecreate (Change Details), changehandle (Change Details), cmdbsync (Configuration Item Synchronization), createjob (Create Job), diagram (Architecture Design), taskConfigList (Step Task Policy), preNode (Previous-Step Node Information (EOA)), step (Step Log), activity (Timeline), relevance (Related Tasks), markrepeat (Duplicate Event), file (Attachment List), reportingHistory (Submission History)."

description.succeed: Trigger notification upon completion of steps
description.transfer: Triggering notification when a user with step-by-step permission transfers the processing permission of the current step to another user
description.urge: Trigger notification when the user urges the completion of a Task
